Boris Johnson is the former UK Prime Minister, serving from 2019 to 2022. He was the 55th Prime Minister, led through 3 of the biggest crises of the last century, and is one of the most controversial characters in the history of the United Kingdom. Boris Johnson is now ‘unleashed’.
